detail.quote: completely snow free top to bottom
detail.text: Kearsarge 8/18, completely snow free top to bottom, dusty even. Bubbs is a rock hop. Flower show is over but the light is getting good. Fall is close up high.

detail.author: sierra_wanderer
detail.text: Back over Kearsarge on the 1st. Big change in three weeks, snow free to maybe 11,500 now, north side field is half the size and there is a clean boot path through it. Nobody in our group used traction. Bubbs down to mid calf. Summer is coming fast.

detail.author: sierra_wanderer
detail.text: Went over Kearsarge on Saturday. Snow free on the east side until about 11,200, then continuous snow to the top. North side still holds a big snowfield maybe 200 feet long. We had microspikes and were glad to have them at 7am, by 10 it was mashed potatoes. Bubbs Creek crossing was knee high and dropping.

detail.author: u/switchbacksally

extraction.quote_span: I was on spikes and wishing for an axe

detail.quote: I was on spikes and wishing for an axe
detail.text: Went in over Kearsarge 6/3 to resupply cache. Continuous snow from the lakes on, north side is a real snowfield with a runout onto rocks, I was on spikes and wishing for an axe. Watched two guys glissade it and it made my stomach turn. I am waiting two weeks before I try Glen.
